title: GitHub settings
description: Configures GitHub settings for the repository. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#github

labels.description: Topic labels describing the repository. At most 20, each lowercase alphanumeric or dashes, at most 35 characters. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#repo_meta

collaborators.description: GitHub usernames of non-committers to grant the triage role. At most 10. Not allowed on private repositories. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#triage

protected_tags.description: Deprecated and no longer applied; use a tag ruleset instead. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#tag_protect

del_branch_on_merge.description: Deprecated; use pull_requests.del_branch_on_merge instead. Mutually exclusive with the pull_requests section. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#delete_branch

autolink_jira.description: Jira project keys to autolink, as a single key or a list. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#autolink

ghp_branch.description: Branch to publish GitHub Pages from. Must be the repository default branch or gh-pages. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#pages

ghp_path.description: Path to publish GitHub Pages from, /docs or /. Any other value falls back to / with a warning. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#pages
